notes: Du lieu test tach roi khoi script theo yeu cau data-driven cua HW04. Test case goc dung 'San pham A' (100.000 d) va 'San pham B' (50.000 d) la san pham gia dinh - khong ton tai trong seed cua database.js. Anh xa sang san pham that co san: A = iPhone 15 Pro Max (id 1), B = Ban phim co Keychron Q1 (id 5). Co y chon 2 id LE vi server.js:162 tra ve price dang STRING cho id chan (row.id % 2 === 0) - dung id le de tranh quirk nay lam nhieu ket qua. Spec KHONG hardcode gia tien: don gia duoc lay tu GET /api/products/:id luc chay, thanh tien va tong cong duoc tinh lai tu do (vua tranh lech khi ai do sua seed, vua tao them 1 assertion pattern doi chieu UI voi API).
knownIssues: ProductDetail.jsx:21-31 - handleAddToCart co bien clickCount: lan bam dau tien chi setClickCount(1) roi return, KHONG them gi vao gio. Phai bam lan 2 moi thuc su goi addToCart. Day la bug nghiem trong nhat cua feature nay.

Hau qua cua bug tren voi thiet ke test: neu seed gio hang qua trang chi tiet bang 1 click, gio se rong - trung khop voi ky vong 'phai bi chan' cua TC-CART-011 va gay FALSE PASS. Vi vay TC-CART-011 co y dung clicks=2 de thuc su kich hoat addToCart va kiem dung dieu can kiem (validation so luong). Nguoc lai TC-CART-001 giu dung clicks=1 theo spec de phoi bay chinh bug clickCount nay.

CartContext.jsx:8-10 - addToCart luon push dong moi (setCart([...cart, {...product, quantity}])), khong tim dong trung de cong don so luong. TC-CART-002 vi vay seed qua nut 'Them vao gio' o trang chu (Home.jsx:97-102) - nut nay goi thang addToCart khong qua clickCount - de bug tao-dong-trung lo ra truc tiep thay vi bi bug clickCount che mat.

Cart.jsx:47 - o So luong la text thuan ({item.quantity}), khong co nut +/- nao. TC-CART-003/004/005 dung kind 'elementMissing': assert nut ton tai truoc, KHONG click vao locator rong de tranh timeout mu mo.
Cart.jsx:50-56 - nut Xoa goi thang removeFromCart(index), khong co window.confirm. TC-CART-007/008 se fail o buoc cho dialog xuat hien.
Cart.jsx:63 - nhan tong tien la 'Tong tam tinh', FR-07 yeu cau dung chu 'Tong cong'.
Cart.jsx:36 - ten cot la 'Gia', FR-07 yeu cau 'Don gia'.

Cart.jsx:66-68 - khi gio CO hang, nut quay lai co nhan '← Mua tiep'; nhung o empty state (Cart.jsx:24) lai dung nhan '_Tiep tuc mua sam'. Nhan khong nhat quan giua 2 trang thai, FR-07 yeu cau 'Tiep tuc mua sam'.
CartContext.jsx:6 - cart la useState([]) thuan, khong luu localStorage/sessionStorage. F5 mat sach gio hang (TC-CART-013).
Cart.jsx:20-27 - empty state chi co chu, khong co icon/hinh minh hoa nhu FR-24 yeu cau (TC-CART-009).
Checkout.jsx + App.jsx:58 - route /checkout KHONG co guard nao. Vao thang URL /checkout khi chua dang nhap van render form thanh toan. Vi pham FR-08, kiem o ve cuoi TC-CART-012.
ProductDetail.jsx:56-61 - o So luong khong co min/required; ProductDetail.jsx:27 dung parseInt(quantity) nen de trong se thanh NaN. Label 'So luong:' khong gan htmlFor/id nen getByLabel() vo dung.

Login.jsx - trang dang nhap dung nhan 'Username' cho o email, nut submit ten 'Sign In' (khong phai 'Dang nhap'), va o mat khau dung type='text' (lo mat khau). Ngoai pham vi FR-07 nhung anh huong cach viet helper dang nhap.
TC-CART-012 va TC-CART-013 chay o trang thai KHACH VANG LAI (requiresAuth=false) dung theo Preconditions ghi trong 2 file test case do, khac voi mac dinh dang nhap cua cac case con lai.
